sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Portuguese studio António Costa Lima Arquitectos has extended the historic Colégio de Santa Maria school in Lisbon, adding a stack of cubic concrete volumes that cascade down to a terrace and playground. The original building was designed in the early 20th century for a Catholic religious congregation and, over the years, has undergone several renovations The post António Costa Lima Arquitectos adds concrete extension to historic Lisbon school appeared first on Dezeen .
